title: Display rules
description: Rules evaluated by StarterKit\Rules\DisplayRuleEvaluator to determine whether a section renders.

include.description: Rules that may make the section visible. When this array is empty or omitted, the section is visible only when entire_site is true.

exclude.description: Matching rules always prevent the section from rendering.

include_relation.description: How include rules are combined. The evaluator defaults to OR when omitted and uppercases the supplied value.

exclude_relation.description: How exclude rules are combined. The evaluator defaults to OR when omitted and uppercases the supplied value.

entire_site.description: Makes the section visible across the site when include is empty, unless scheduling, device, or exclude rules prevent it.

start_date.description: Inclusive schedule start date in the Y-m-d format expected by the evaluator, for example 2026-08-26.

end_date.description: Inclusive schedule end date in the Y-m-d format expected by the evaluator, for example 2026-08-26.

device.description: Device visibility: all or an empty string matches every device; any other value must exactly match context.device.

rule.description: One rule evaluated against the resolved page context.
